num_items: <int> Number of items available for selection into the knapsack.
capacity: <int> Maximum total weight the knapsack can hold.

items.profits: <list[int], length num_items> Profit earned by placing each item in the knapsack.
items.weights: <list[int], length num_items> Weight consumed in the knapsack by each item.

conflict_graph.num_vertices: <int> Number of vertices in the conflict graph, equal to the number of items.
conflict_graph.num_edges: <int> Number of edges in the conflict graph.
conflict_graph.edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Pairs of item indices that conflict and cannot both be placed in the knapsack.
